name: Mineweb Addons for Elementor
author: MINEWEB STUDIO

sections.description:
Mineweb Addons for Elementor adds custom Elementor widgets and extensions:

  • Image Marquee widget
  • Text Marquee widget
  • Gallery With Featured Image dynamic tag
  • Additional Elementor entrance animations

The plugin requires Elementor 3.20.0 or newer. It does not require Elementor Pro.

Mineweb Addons for Elementor is an independent addon and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elementor Ltd.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress admin.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  4. Use the new MWAFE category when adding widgets in Elementor.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor Pro?

No. The plugin works with the free version of Elementor.

What is the minimum supported Elementor version?

Elementor 3.20.0 or newer is required.
